column1: # STAR WARS Battlefront Classic Collection (Switch, 2024; base game + update 1.0.4 = v262144), SDK 16.
# Vulkan: the collection's REI renderer compiles its GLSL to SPIR-V at run time, so the RomFS holds no SPIR-V at all and the profile lists the keys the packer captures (vk_capture.tsv).
# One launcher (nro1) and two games behind it, Battlefront (nro0) and Battlefront II (nro2), loaded with nn::ro as NROs of the launcher's process.
# The memory partition is the survey's guess (dm/games/profile_guess.py), not measured on this title: it is the partition the shipped app was packed from.
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL), subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_Vulkan)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# every staged buffer this title copies proves its padded layout by its own size (C_COPYB2I's layouts A and B, for 2D images and the 3D light volumes),
# so the ambiguous "buffer larger than either padded total" case does not arise and no texture key is set

column2: STAR WARS™: Battlefront Classic Collection has no NVN shaders (its SPIR-V shaders go through the Vulkan layer)
